question: Who among the following was the author of Buddhacharita ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashvaghosha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ashvaghosha was a prominent Indian philosopher, poet, and dramatist in the Buddhist tradition.
 
• He is considered one of the greatest Indian poets, second only to Kalidasa.
 
• His most celebrated work is the "Buddhacharita," an epic poem detailing the life of the Buddha.
 
• Ashvaghosha's writings played a significant role in spreading Mahayana Buddhism in India and beyond.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buddhacharita**

 
 
• It is an epic poem written by Ashvaghosha in the early 2nd century CE.
 
 
• **Ashvaghosha**
 
 
• He was born in Saketa in Northern India and was initially a Brahmin.
 
• Ashvaghosha converted to Buddhism after debating with a renowned Buddhist monk, Parsva.
 
• He served as a spiritual advisor to the Kushan emperor Kanishka.
 
• Besides "Buddhacharita," his other famous works include "Saundarananda" and "Sutralankara."
 
 
 
• **Buddhism**
 
 
• Buddhism is a major world religion founded by Siddhartha Gautama (the Buddha) in the 5th century BCE.
 
• The core teachings of Buddhism include the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path.
 
• Buddhism emphasizes the attainment of enlightenment (nirvana) through ethical conduct, meditation, and wisdom.
 
• There are two main branches of Buddhism: Theravada and Mahayana.
